Black just captures the rook or moves the king. Either way, Black is up massive material (winning queen and rook for nothing). This is completely winning.

**Best move:** Rd2+

**Main line:** Rd2+ Qxd2 Bxd2 Rb7+ Kh8 (or any move)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching Note:**

When the opponent's king is checked, look for pieces the king is forced to undefend. Here, Rd2+ checks the king on g2 while simultaneously attacking the undefended queen on c2. The king must move (or the queen must capture on d2), but after Qxd2, your bishop takes Bxd2 and wins the queen outright. This is a **royal fork**—using a check to hit the king and a piece it was defending. When your opponent moves a piece to fight back, see if it leaves something else hanging.
